channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Babcock offers drone warships with British frigates in 2027
item.description: Speaking under the hulls of Type 31 Frigates at Rosyth, Babcock’s senior leadership told the UK Defence Journal how they intend to meet the First Sea Lord’s call for rapid expansion of autonomous mass at sea, with a drone ship alongside HMS Venturer in 2027. The post Babcock offers drone warships with British frigates in 2027 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: The First Sea Lord wants a Navy built for risk, nothing less
item.description: Britain’s grip on the Atlantic is slipping, the First Sea Lord told the Council of Geostrategy’s Sea Power Conference, urging a fleet rebuilt for speed, autonomy and adaptation so the Royal Navy can hold the line in a world tilting toward danger. The post The First Sea Lord wants a Navy built for risk, nothing less first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Former Sea Lord warns UK subs in worst shape for decades
item.description: Lord West of Spithead warned that the attack submarine force has reached what he called "the worst state in my 60 years of service". The post Former Sea Lord warns UK subs in worst shape for decades first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Rosyth shipyard skills hailed after US submarine deal
item.description: Rosyth, Dunfermline and Dollar MP Graeme Downie argued, is no longer only a national asset but a trusted node within the defence industrial networks of Britain’s closest allies. The post Rosyth shipyard skills hailed after US submarine deal first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British patrol ship ‘opens fire’, crosses Equator
item.description: The Royal Navy’s Caribbean-based patrol vessel HMS Medway has conducted live gunnery exercises in equatorial waters. The post British patrol ship ‘opens fire’, crosses Equator first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Poland taps JFD Global for new submarine rescue capability
item.description: JFD Global has secured a significant contract to deliver the core hyperbaric and saturation diving systems for the Polish Navy’s new salvage and rescue vessel, Ratownik. The post Poland taps JFD Global for new submarine rescue capability first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Defence Committee chair warns of Army vehicle ‘shambles’
item.description: The Defence Committee chair said the Army’s armoured vehicle woes now amount to "an absolute shambles," as ministers ordered external experts to investigate fresh Ajax injuries and wider failures across key land fleets. The post Defence Committee chair warns of Army vehicle ‘shambles’ first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: ARCIMS drone launches KATFISH minehunting system
item.description: ARCIMS autonomously launched and recovered the KATFISH sonar system during NATO trials off Portland, demonstrating a new combined capability for rapid mine countermeasures and seabed inspection. The post ARCIMS drone launches KATFISH minehunting system first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: GMB warns delays threaten future of Ferguson Marine yard
item.description: GMB Scotland has accused the Scottish Government of allowing avoidable delays in ferry procurement to jeopardise the future of Ferguson Marine, the union stated. The post GMB warns delays threaten future of Ferguson Marine yard first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK goes ‘all in’ on AUKUS as nuke sub delivery phase begins
item.description: The UK, US and Australia have declared AUKUS "full steam ahead" after Washington completed its internal review, with all three governments shifting from planning to delivery of submarines and advanced tech. The post UK goes ‘all in’ on AUKUS as nuke sub delivery phase begins first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
